SolidEdgeCustomSettings.Description:
Solid Edge custom.xml file. The contents within the custom hole sizes section of this file populate the Saved Settings on the dialog for the Hole command.
This file must be located in the Solid Edge program directory. For example: c:\Program Files\Solid Edge\Program\Custom.xml
If you edit the list you should copy the file before uninstalling Solid Edge.

Bolt.FastenerName: Hexagon socket head cap screw ASME/ANSI B18.3.A 1/2-13 UNC
